messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.38-2 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.38-21 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This is a bug fix and documentation upgrade.   Steve Ellner found a bug in 'nlf' that was easy to fix.  Steve also provided a section on NLF for the "intro to pomp" vignette.

For specific changes, see the NEWS file.

Best regards,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan

messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.38-3 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.38-3 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries 
should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This is just 
a documentation upgrade.  Most importantly, the 'eulermultinom' functions are 
now fully documented, but inaccuracies and incomplete descriptions in the 
help pages for 'pomp', 'plugins', 'bsplines', 'dacca', 'gompertz', 
and 'simulate', have been remedied.  Also, the "intro to pomp" vignette 
section on the SIR model has been improved.

Best regards,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
